description: Rank telescopes by their share of all signals and return every telescope whose share is at least the 10th-highest share, including all ties at the cut.

a.request: For each telescope reference (`telescref`) in the signals table, count its signals and compute that count as an unrounded fraction of all signals. Show the telescope reference, the signal count and the fraction, sorted by fraction from highest to lowest, and return the top 10, including every telescope tied with the 10th one even if that gives more than 10 rows.
a.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), ranked AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, signal_count * 1.0 / SUM(signal_count) OVER () AS fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count DESC) AS signal_rank FROM telescope_counts) SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE signal_rank <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, telescref;

c.request: What are the top 10 telescopes by share of detected signals? For each telescope reference (`telescref`), show how many signals it detected and what fraction of all signals that is (unrounded), from the largest share down. Rank telescopes by their share of all signals and return every telescope whose share is at least the 10th-highest share, including all ties at the cut.
c.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), ranked AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, CAST(signal_count AS REAL) / SUM(signal_count) OVER () AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count DESC) AS share_rank FROM telescope_counts) SELECT telescref, signal_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, telescref;

b.request: For each telescope reference (`signals.telescref`), count its detected signals and calculate the unrounded count divided by the total number of signals; return every telescope with a share at least as high as the 10th-highest share, including ties, ordered by share descending
b.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), ranked AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, signal_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count DESC) AS share_rank FROM telescope_counts) SELECT telescref, signal_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, telescref;

d.request: Rank telescope references (`telescref`) by their share of all detected signals, from largest to smallest. For each, show the number of signals detected and its unrounded fraction of all signals. Include every telescope whose share is at least the 10th-highest share, including ties at the cutoff.
d.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), ranked AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, SUM(signal_count) OVER () AS total_signals, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count DESC) AS share_rank FROM counts) SELECT telescref, signal_count, CAST(signal_count AS REAL) / total_signals AS share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY signal_count DESC, telescref;
